reels.title: A week without sleep, and then a homily: “Jesus will not divorce you”
reels.hook: His marriage was falling apart. He heard the answer at early Mass.
reels.why: It has a clear arc, from a desperate prayer on his knees to a homily that strikes him right in the wound. It ends with a human, almost humorous detail about the priest.
reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
reels.quote: Jesus will not divorce you, Jesus will not divorce you.

cards.text: His marriage was falling apart. He heard the answer at early Mass.
Kevin Monette, Encounter Ministries
Sixth year of marriage, and his wife Rose is considering an annulment.
If you can save my marriage, I will give you everything.
“Jesus will not divorce you.”
Kevin Monette – Testimony

reels.title: His wife suggested an annulment and that he become a priest
reels.hook: His wife offered him an “exit” from the marriage
reels.why: The shocking and concrete logic of the crisis is stated in a few sentences, and the point is an honest “biggest blow in life”. The viewer stays because of the tension.
reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
reels.quote: Kevin, I am desperate in marriage with you.

reels.title: “You love ministry more than me”: resignation after one sentence
reels.hook: He led hundreds of people. Then he resigned.
reels.why: The conflict of a believer in ministry and family is universal. His wife's sentence, the spiritual director's advice, and the resignation the next day build a clear and courageous turn.
reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
reels.quote: Kevin, you love your ministry more than you love me.

reels.title: A predator instead of a protector: a 30-year-old wound and forgiveness
reels.hook: A 30-year-old wound. The choice: anger or forgiveness.
reels.why: A powerful, well-rounded story about uncovering a wound and making a free decision to forgive. It ends with a touching image of the couple before the altar.
reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
reels.quote: But when we uncover a wound, that does not heal it.

reels.title: The bald prophet, two bears, and a lesson on rudeness in marriage
reels.hook: The strangest biblical passage about rudeness
reels.why: A little-known and shocking biblical story is told with humor. At the end comes unexpectedly practical advice for marriage.
reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
reels.quote: But I am sure the Lord does not like rudeness toward those he loves.

reels.speaker: Kevin Monette
